inspect.title: Inspect
inspect.nothingKnown: Nothing is known about this creature yet.
inspect.acHowTo: Narrows with every attack that lands or misses.
inspect.hpHowTo: Estimated once one has been bloodied or felled.
inspect.forgetObserved: Forget what the players have worked out

reveal.acPinned: The players have pinned {name}'s armour class at {ac}.

contextMenu.name: Right-click menu for players
contextMenu.hint: Players right-click any token they can see but do not own to Inspect or Target it; owners keep the token HUD, which gains an Inspect button of its own.

revealOnDamage.name: Defences reveal themselves
revealOnDamage.hint: When applied damage is changed by a creature's resistance, immunity or vulnerability, that defence appears on its Inspect sheet automatically.

observeCombat.name: Armour and health are learned in combat
observeCombat.hint: Every attack that hits or misses a creature narrows its armour class on Inspect, and every creature bloodied or felled bounds its hit points. Off, Inspect shows neither line.

announceReveals.name: Whisper reveals to the GM
announceReveals.hint: A whispered chat line whenever a defence reveals itself, so you know the players' knowledge moved without keeping the Inspect window open.

showRelationships.name: Show relationships on friendly NPCs
showRelationships.hint: When Relationship Tracker is active, inspecting a friendly NPC also shows how that NPC feels about the person looking.

chatDescriptions.name: Use chat descriptions
chatDescriptions.hint: Anything without a chat description falls back to its full text.
